_comment: Outposts: a second castle with its own buildings, storage and production, founded on the free castle spot nearest your home once your keep reaches keep_needed (cost taken from your main castle). Each outpost works a region that adds `bonus` to one resource's production. An outpost may build only `types`, its keep up to keep_cap. Carts carry resources between your castles, up to cart_share of the sending castle's storage per trip (at least cart_min), at the marching speed (data/barons.json march_speed); what doesn't fit in the storage when they arrive is lost.
